name: linalg_solve
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_solve(Tensor A, Tensor B, *, bool left=True) -> Tensor. Solves AX=B without mutating or aliasing A or B. Tests preserve unbatched and batched float32/float64 coverage and add noncontiguous, empty-batch, metadata, non-mutation, invalid-shape, and the current kernel left=False rejection contracts.
